items.summary: Use when writing or upgrading a Sentio Sui processor on SDK 4 that touches RAW transaction / object / event structures — e.g. reading fields off `ctx.transac...
items.description: Use when writing or upgrading a Sentio Sui processor on SDK 4 that touches RAW transaction / object / event structures — e.g. reading fields off `ctx.transaction`, walking programmable-transaction commands, decoding an object from `ctx.client.getObject`, or parsing Move type strings. On SDK 4 Sui chain data is fetched over gRPC, so these raw shapes follow the Sui gRPC protobuf schema and differ from the JSON-RPC shapes used by earlier SDK versions (field names, nesting, protobuf oneof unions, and type-string formatting). Not needed for typed handlers that only use `event.data_decoded`.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of sui-grpc-data-format.
- Documents how raw Sui transaction/object/event structures have changed in Sentio SDK 4 (gRPC, protobuf-based) versus older JSON-RPC formats.
- Details key differences: protobuf `oneof` usage, camelCase field names, new event and transaction data nesting.
- Provides guidelines and code snippets for handling Move type string parsing and address normalization.
- Includes an upgrade checklist for adapting existing processors to the new data shapes.
